youtubeTitle: Married at 16 to escape poverty. Today she's the state's first woman joint director.
caption:
Married at 16 to escape poverty. Today she's the state's first woman joint director.

Savita Pradhan grew up in a tribal family in Mandai village, Madhya Pradesh, gathering tendu leaves and mahua flowers to survive. Forced into marriage young, she endured domestic abuse before finishing her MA and learning about state civil service jobs. She cleared the Madhya Pradesh state civil services exam on her first attempt, then cleared it again in 2006 with an 83rd rank, entering the Madhya Pradesh Administrative Service. She is now the state's first woman joint director in the urban administration department and runs a YouTube channel called 'Himmat Wali Ladkiyan' (Brave Girls) to mentor other women out of the same circumstances she escaped.
